subject: Process HWPX template with inventory data
description:
Create and run a Python script to:
1. Load JSON data from /root/inventory_data.json
2. Parse the XML from /tmp/hwpx_work/Contents/section0.xml
3. For each paragraph with placeholders, concatenate text, replace {{key}} with JSON values
4. Remove hp:linesegarray elements from modified paragraphs
5. Preserve empty paragraphs and Korean labels
6. Write modified XML and repackage as /root/inventory_report_ready.hwpx
